description.narrative: This assignment aims at assessing the institutional capacity of IARNA-URL to manage and implement the proposed project (based on previous implemented projects and experiences with other donors), as well as its competence to deliver planned results and expected impacts, internal management and control of the Organisations. The consultant is expected to identify eventual weaknesses. The Capacity Assessment would be emphasized in the managerial and financial capacities, procedures and routines of the Rafael Landívar University, as well as the administrative schemes and their relationship with IARNA.
